title: Egypt gives assurance to facilitate Malaysian humanitarian aid to Gaza, says Anwar
desc: KUALA LUMPUR: Egypt has given a clear guarantee and commitment to facilitate the distribution of 374 tonnes of humanitarian aid from Malaysia to the Palestinian population in Gaza through the Rafah border crossing starting this April, says Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim.

title: PETRONAS denies involvement in reported Philippine fuel supply deal
desc: KUALA LUMPUR: Petroliam Nasional Bhd (PETRONAS) has denied any involvement in a reported fuel supply deal involving a local government unit in the Philippines.
